source_receipt.validation: pinned S3 object ETag on every range, per-chunk SHA256, complete size and HDF5 signature; source multipart ETag is not a published MD5

normalization_library: sum over all 18129 published genes before transformation
gene_universe: all published pseudobulk reference genes; no pooled DE HVG subset
sample_filter: n_cells >= 5; nonnegative finite counts; positive aggregated library; no effect/significance filtering
precision: float32 accumulation and transformed cache; library totals float64
limitation: published curated target annotations and primary target coverage universe retained; not raw re-alignment or re-curation
